name: Set of four inlay stools
material: Carved wood, brass and coloured inlay
description: A set of four square stools in graduated inlay patterns, each top set with a different star or floral design and finished with a brass edge. Use them as seats, side tables or a display stand.

name: Mosaic glass lantern lamps
description: Hand-assembled lantern lamps in coloured mosaic glass on a wooden base. Lit, they throw a warm, patterned glow, and they look best on a console or bedside table.

name: Inlay lidded round box
description: A round lidded box in polished wood with a leaf-and-vine inlay on the lid and a turned wooden knob. A useful piece for dry fruits, snacks or small keepsakes, and a good gift.

name: Carved keepsake box with brass latch
description: A hand-carved wooden box with a brass latch and a carved front and lid, shown here on an inlay round table. It keeps jewellery, papers and small treasures.

name: Nested square serving trays
description: A nested set of square wooden trays, each with a metal medallion inlay at the centre and cut-out handles. Use them together for serving or stack them away when not in use.

name: Carved wooden wall clocks
description: Round wall clocks in carved wooden frames, with patterned dials in gold, cream and dark finishes. Pick the dial and frame that suit your wall.

name: Carved wall brackets and mirror frames
description: Carved wall brackets, jharokha-style mirror frames and small shelves for hanging in a hall or entrance. Many sizes and patterns are in the shop.

name: Carved side tables
description: Square side tables with carved tops and turned legs. They suit a sofa side, a bedside or a pooja corner.

name: Nested round wooden trays
description: Round wooden trays in graduated sizes with a dark, hand-polished finish. Use them for serving, for display or as a base for candles and diyas.

name: Inlay round platter
description: A round wooden platter with a floral inlay across the top and a shallow dish at the centre. It works for serving and as a table piece.

name: Carved console table
description: A dark polished console table with a carved apron, turned front legs and a lower stretcher. Place it in a hall or entrance. Ask us about its age and history when you visit.

name: Cane-back settee
description: A two-seat settee with a woven cane back, a padded green seat and slim turned legs. Ask us about its age and history when you visit.

name: Canopy jhoola seat
description: A traditional jhoola-style seat with an iron canopy, ready for a veranda, courtyard or large living room. Ask us about its age and history when you visit.

name: Hand-turned wooden goblets
description: A pair of goblets turned from solid wood with a smooth natural finish and a stable base. They make a distinctive gift set.

name: Painted wooden serving tray
description: A long serving tray with raised ends and a carved, painted pattern across the base. Good for tea, snacks and gifting.

name: Carved square stools
description: Square stools with deeply carved tops in floral and geometric patterns. Each pattern is different, so pick the one you like.

name: Brass-studded square tables
description: Square tables with carved geometric tops dotted with brass studs. They come in several patterns and can be made in your size.

name: Inlay rectangular tray
description: A rectangular wooden tray with a pierced border and a star-pattern inlay at the centre. Use it for serving or hang it as wall decor.

name: Wood-finish steel mug
description: A mug with a wood-finish outer body, a steel lining and a comfortable handle, printed with a morning message. A simple gift for tea and coffee drinkers.

name: Charminar glass showpiece
description: A Charminar model under a glass dome on a lit base, in two sizes. A souvenir of Hyderabad and a popular gift.

name: Floral carved wooden panel
description: A square piece carved by hand with a flowing floral pattern and a central flower. Hung as wall art or made into a box lid or table top to order.
